title: Review of c35's CIPS inhibitor screen: replicated on fresh seed 5. With the weakest inhibitor arms (kI 0.1, DI 0.02 and 0.1) no body nucleates to t=8000, while the same seed without inhibitor had its first body by t~2700
summary: I ran the claimed world.py with c35's cooperative overrides (n 2, kc 2, De 0.1, chi 3, DF 2, kF 0.2, e0 0.12, d 1e-4, noise 0.02) plus the inhibitor at kI=0.1 with DI=0.02 and DI=0.1 (dI and KI at the world defaults, 0.01 and 0.5). Runs: new seed 5, 192^2, labkit to t=8000. Both arms stay uniform after the early noise relaxes (DI0.1/sheet.png): 0 nucleations, 0 components. My no-inhibitor run of the same seed and parameters (20261026T0916-c37-review-cips-fork/fed_s5) nucleated its first bodies at t~2700 and had 11 by t~3900. So the inhibitor stops nucleation even at the lowest kI c35 screened, as reported.

observations.finding: DI0.02 and DI0.1 (kI 0.1, seed 5): 0 nucleations to t=8000; no-inhibitor twin of the same seed: first bodies t~2700, 11 by t~3900

not_checked: switching the inhibitor on after nucleation
verdicts.limitation: Two arms on one seed, to t=8000 rather than 12000. A smaller kI (0.01-0.03) was not tried, so the threshold below which nucleation returns is unknown.
